The build passes. 

I implemented the change by extending `BusinessDayResolver.toBusinessDay` in `src/main/java/.../rest/controller/BusinessDayResolver.java`:

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set with the five fixed dates (2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28).
- Replaced the single Saturday/Sunday→Monday jump with a loop that rolls the date forward one day at a time until it lands on a non-weekend, non-holiday day.
- Extracted the "is this a business day?" check into a small private `isBusinessDay` helper so the roll-forward loop reads cleanly and the weekend/holiday rule lives in one place.

This keeps the resolver as the single home for the business-day rule — the controller (`OwnerRestControllerV1`) continues to call `toBusinessDay` unchanged, so the stored `registrationDate`, membership-number year segment, and per-day create limit all inherit the holiday roll-forward automatically. The build reports `BUILD SUCCESS` with all tests green.
